sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original horizontal navigation illustration for the Nameless fantasy MMORPG website, intended for a landscape 16:9 tile.
Primary request: a restrained, painterly exploration scene that leads the eye along a stone footpath and a clearly constructed arched stone bridge towards an imposing tiered fantasy citadel on a floating rock formation. This is decorative category art for exploration, not a map of a real server.
Style/medium: polished painted fantasy concept art, believable architectural volumes, selectively placed brush detail, clear silhouettes. Natural materials: weathered blue-grey cut stone, dark oak and subtle old brass accents.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape. A single obvious focal citadel in the upper centre-right, kept fully inside the image with breathing room around its pinnacle. The path crosses the lower-left into the middle ground. Strong foreground/middle ground/distant mountain separation. Keep the bottom fifth comparatively calm and dark enough for separate HTML title overlay; do not render any title.
Lighting/mood: gentle ivory daylight from the upper left, lightly misted distance, luminous sky, readable blue-grey stone and natural green vegetation. Quiet exploration, depth and openness. The environment must be bright enough to read at thumbnail scale.
Color palette: navy shadows, slate and blue-grey stone, natural restrained green, ivory sunlight and very small antique gold accents.
Constraints: coherent perspective, plausible masonry and bridge supports; one focal scene rather than many disconnected landmarks. No people, no monsters, no weapons, no cartographic symbols or route markers, no labels, no lettering, no logo, no frame, no border, no interface, no watermark.
Avoid: mobile game illustration, fluorescent glow, neon cyan crystals, generic magic particles, highly busy details, excessive bloom, surreal warped architecture, oversaturated purple, hard black shadows.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original horizontal Bestiary navigation illustration for the Nameless fantasy MMORPG website, a 16:9 landscape tile.
Input images: Image 1 is the EXACT SUBJECT reference from the server, a Petit Slime Minecraft render. Image 2 is a STYLE AND LIGHTING reference only; do not reproduce its castle, bridge or composition.
Primary request: depict a SINGLE small green gelatinous cube slime faithfully based on Image 1, resting in a damp woodland glade. Keep its unmistakable Minecraft identity: broad cubical body, flat top and visible square sides, translucent bright green gelatin with sparse subtle block-like patches, exactly two deep dark square eyes on its front face, no mouth. The lower body can lightly settle into the moss but must remain cubical.
Style/medium: the same restrained painted fantasy concept art treatment as Image 2, believable natural volumes, painterly surfaces and selected detail. The slime silhouette should still look cubic rather than rounded or sculpted into a generic jelly creature.
Scene/backdrop: blue-grey stones, low moss, shallow still water, a few reeds and distant trees. The woodland is an illustrative category backdrop, not a claim about a server location.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9, one focal slime in the upper centre-right occupying roughly the central third of the frame; show its full silhouette. View at a slight three-quarter angle comparable to Image 1. Quiet negative space on the left and in the bottom fifth for a separate HTML title overlay; no title inside the image.
Lighting/mood: soft ivory daylight from the upper left, gentle mist in the background, readable natural green body and slate blue-grey surroundings, calm adventurous atmosphere.
Color palette: navy and petroleum shadows, grey-blue stone, natural green, ivory daylight. No fluorescent glow.
Constraints: subject fidelity is essential. No limbs, teeth, spikes, crown, clothing, armour, weapons, horns, slime companions, people, false game statistics, text, labels, logo, frame, border, interface, watermark. Do not anthropomorphize it.
Avoid: circular eyes, round blobs, exaggerated cute face, mobile game cartoon style, neon halos, excessive magical particles, hyper-detailed noise, oversaturated purple.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original horizontal Objects navigation illustration for the Nameless fantasy MMORPG website, a 16:9 landscape tile.
Input images: Image 1 is the STYLE AND LIGHTING reference only. Match its restrained painted fantasy treatment, blue-grey materials, ivory daylight and clear volumes; do not reproduce its castle or outdoor scene.
Primary request: a quiet fantasy artisan's equipment workshop, presenting ONE clearly identifiable straight steel sword and ONE plausible kite shield, arranged on a broad dark oak workbench beside a blue-grey stone window. These are generic category decorations, never replicas or replacements of named game inventory items.
Subject: the sword has a single symmetrical straight blade, central fuller, simple brass crossguard, wrapped dark leather handle and small round pommel, with every part geometrically aligned along one straight axis. Rest it diagonally on the bench with the hilt lower-right and tip upper-centre; leave the whole sword visible. Beside it, a restrained slate-blue kite shield with a simple antique brass edge and no emblem, resting upright against stone.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9. Concentrate the equipment focal group in the upper centre-right with generous room around it. Workshop depth recedes to the left, subtle shelves in the background with a few plain tools only. The bottom fifth is visually quiet and dark enough for a separate HTML title overlay; do not add any title.
Lighting/mood: soft ivory daylight entering from the upper-left window, calm navy shadows, readable worn metal surfaces and natural oak. Light temperature consistent with the reference; modest old-gold metal accents, no glowing machinery.
Style/medium: polished painted fantasy concept art, credible perspective and material construction, deliberate level of detail, no glossy advertising render.
Constraints: two main pieces of equipment only, straight coherent blade, single handle and crossguard, plausible shield shape. No people, no hands, no floating equipment, no magical runes, no readable documents, no typography, no text, no logo, no frame, no border, no interface, no watermark.
Avoid: ornate impossible weapons, crooked blade, double hilts, melted edges, excessive clutter, neon glow, sparks, mobile game cartoon style, photographic overdetail, oversaturated purple.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original horizontal Guild navigation illustration for the Nameless fantasy MMORPG website, a 16:9 landscape tile.
Input images: Image 1 is the STYLE, MATERIAL AND LIGHTING reference only. Match its restrained painted fantasy treatment, blue-grey stone, ivory daylight, natural oak and antique brass; do not copy its sword or shield.
Primary request: an inviting, empty adventurers' council room built from weathered blue-grey stone and dark oak, organized around ONE large oak table with several simple chairs. A tall arched window opens toward a misty mountainous fantasy environment. The room evokes a guild headquarters without inventing actual members, events, crests or game information.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9. The main table occupies the upper centre-right and recedes coherently into the room; leave all table legs and chair supports structurally plausible. Camera eye level at a gentle three-quarter view. A few rolled blank ivory papers and closed plain books rest neatly at one end, otherwise the tabletop is empty. The bottom fifth and left foreground remain visually quiet and in navy shadows for a separate HTML title overlay.
Lighting/mood: gentle ivory daylight from the upper-left arched window, clear softly lit table surfaces, subtle reflected warm light, slate shadows. Calm, useful, welcoming room, consistent daylight temperature with the reference. No dramatic central fire or magic effects.
Style/medium: polished painted fantasy concept art, believable architectural perspective, deliberately limited detail and clear silhouettes. Blue-grey carved stone, substantial natural oak wood, plain leather chair seats and tiny antique brass details.
Constraints: no people, no silhouettes of fictional members, no statues of people, no weapons, no real map on the table or wall, no inscriptions, no readable books, no invented banners or logo, no text, no UI, no border, no frame, no watermark.
Avoid: ornate throne room, excessive decoration, cluttered tavern, modern furniture, neon crystals, fluorescent glow, particles, oversaturated orange or purple, warped table/chair geometry, mobile game cartoon style, artificial oversharpening.
